name: Direttore Pellicano
look: a tall pelican standing upright on two legs, body of polished mirror chrome, wearing a charcoal double-breasted business suit with a crimson silk tie, enormous mirrored aviator sunglasses covering the eyes, long chrome beak, clutching a tiny oxblood leather briefcase under one wing
personality: Speaks entirely in corporate strategy language about situations that have nothing to do with business. Treats every unfolding catastrophe as a scheduling matter. Is never, under any circumstances, surprised.

name: Ranocchia Piccola
look: a very small pale green ceramic frog with enormous glossy black eyes, a fine hairline crack running down one cheek, wearing an oversized mustard-yellow knitted scarf wound several times around its neck, matte glazed finish, sitting hunched with both front feet together
personality: Catastrophizes quietly and very specifically, in a small worried voice. Is always, eventually, exactly right about what was going to happen, and takes no satisfaction whatsoever in it.

name: Nonna Frigorifero
look: a squat vintage cream-enamel refrigerator standing on four stubby chrome legs, an elderly woman's face moulded into the freezer door with deep smile lines and small round spectacles, a floral apron tied around its middle, door hanging slightly ajar and spilling warm yellow light
personality: Offers food that does not exist to people who did not ask for it. Runs on a conversational track parallel to everyone else's that never once intersects. Entirely unbothered.
